scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n pb,server,client -c gray,blue,green "npm run pb" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.pb:mock: cd pocketbase && ./pocketbase superuser upsert dev-superuser@scribator.test dev-superuser-password --dir=pb_data_mock --migrationsDir=pb_migrations && ./pocketbase serve --http=127.0.0.1:8090 --dir=pb_data_mock --migrationsDir=pb_migrations --hooksDir=pb_hooks
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n pb,mock,server,client -c gray,magenta,blue,green "npm run pb:mock" "npm run mock:openrouter -w server" "npm run dev:mock -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --build && P=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml port caddy 80) && echo "Scribator : http://$P (admin PB : http://$P/pb/_/)"
